fee_notes: $55,000 for Large Market (up to 150,000 pre-1990 homes); $45,000 for Small Market (up to 100,000 pre-1990 homes). In 2025 charged $0-$55,000. Discounts available: 20% military/first responder, 25% multi-unit (3+), waived for Conversion Franchisees, up to 10% hard-to-serve markets. Franchise Option Program refunds fee in exchange for royalty increase to 9% for 10 years.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $55,000 for the Large Market territory, and an initial franchise fee of $45,000 for the Small Market territory. In 2025 we charged an Initial Franchise Fee ranging from $0 to $55,000.
